assessor: Assistant editorial assessment of actual complete Gemini output; not generator self-score or independent blinded human review

evidence.hlni: The inspected shared management-course title corrects the accounting-only belief. Exact programme/cohort scope is supported by the cited sources; make the specialisation labels readable in source footage.
evidence.differentiation: The evidence-led correction is recognisably Trust. No fresh three-channel comparison or broader topic generalisation is claimed.
evidence.coherence: The student excludes B.Com, sees the supplied management-course row, and restores that same option. The original motive and action remain connected throughout.
evidence.payoff: The rejected option visibly returns to an investigation/pending/provisional list. This corrects the particular exclusion without treating shared titles as equivalent teaching or selecting a final degree.
evidence.production: Six practical timed scenes, source-document inserts and concise speech. Hold exact programme/version labels and clarify source cropping before filming. Estimated pacing is not a recorded read-aloud.
evidence.originality: The folder/post-it shortlist reversal is clear but familiar rather than highly novel.

reasons: This Trust-only pilot passes the 85 editorial floor, not the above-90 improvement target.
The score does not grant application approval, prove reviewer accuracy or establish three-channel differentiation.
revisions: Hold exact programme names and the cohort visibly on the source inserts.

methodology: The full returned storyboard, HLNI, concept spine, production notes and warnings were read. The same assistant implemented and assessed the change. Scores use the unchanged rubric. Channel differentiation here assesses the recognisable Trust experience against the approved channel objectives and archived references; a fresh three-channel group comparison was not performed. No recorded read-aloud or deployed-app test was performed.
runSummary: Third final-source repetition returned six scenes. Its optional advisory rewrite failed output checks; the actual validated initial Draft is assessed, not the rejected rewrite.
crossChannelFinding: Only Trust was generated in this run. Other channels were deliberately held back pending repeatable Trust acceptance. Output remains Draft and no model review grants application approval.
nextStep: Preserve all repetitions. One requested-channel failure prevents a repeatability pass; keep other-channel expansion and deployment on hold.
